escena: SCENE (sales operations desk, Santiago, late morning): the subject is the REVISION MARKS on top of the work. A printed deal record lies on the desk, tidy and complete, and across it someone has written by hand in ink — a short note in the margin and a circled line. Those handwritten marks are the sharpest, most detailed thing in the frame and the first place the eye lands. A low raking window light lifts the tooth of the paper and the relief of the ink. At most a blurred fragment of a forearm touches the very edge of the frame; no face, no hand as subject. Behind, far out of focus, a monitor is a glowing cool blue display with a CRM record open, and a small orange shape sits at the corner of its bezel. 100mm macro lens at f/4, focus on the handwriting. Everything except that small orange shape is completely unbranded. No readable text anywhere: the handwriting and the printed lines are legible as marks but too small, angled and shallow-focused to read as words.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the dark oak desk against the lens

texto.muro: the bare dark oak desktop continuing above, evenly lit and empty, its grain visible
